rivals.reason: The California T offers a turbocharged V8 with a distinct Ferrari exhaust note, making it a compelling alternative to the R8.
The C8 Corvette features a mid-engine design and a powerful V8 that produces a loud, aggressive sound, positioning it as a direct rival to the R8.
The 718 Cayman GTS 4.0 brings a naturally aspirated flat-six engine with a unique exhaust note that car enthusiasts will appreciate alongside the R8.
The AMG GT pairs a powerful V8 engine with a ferocious exhaust sound, making it a worthy competitor to the R8 in performance and aural appeal.
